baseline_expectation: Each case reproduces a known false-success or identity failure against its pre-fix owner surface.

cases.failure: knowledge_propose reports success without durable readback
cases.expected: durable_id and readback proof are absent or state is unchanged

cases.failure: registered hook runs without packet delivery
root grant reads an unenrolled child repository
one ordinary edit invalidates the complete graph
cases.expected: bounded file delta is not applied

cases.failure: graph body and generation envelope disagree
cases.expected: generation digest does not match published rows

cases.failure: unrelated successful shell command satisfies a criterion

cases.expected: stable RuleKey resolves one existing durable ID

cases.failure: typed field disappears during manifest round-trip
assess returns structured content outside declared MCP output schema
cases.expected: schema validation rejects the response before fix

cases.failure: dirty overlay receipt has no session/worktree identity
cases.expected: concurrent sessions cannot distinguish overlay state
